To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the blended combustion of oil-shale and semi-coke can be divided into two zones,with a mutual influence in the middle zone.

the combustion kinetics of oil shale and blended oil shale and semi-cokewere studied by using the distributed activated energy model(DAEN).The results indicated dual peaks of oil shale combustion were influenced by oil shale and 50℃ semi-coke,while the apparent activation energy was between 60 and80 kJ·mol -1 at the early stage of the combustion and between 80 and200 kJ·m-1at the later stage.
the dual peaks of oil shale combustion are attributed to the combustion reactivity of aliphatic and aromatic components,and that the influence of semi-coke on oil shale combustion is significant.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dual peaks combustion reactivity,ignition temperature,combustibility index and combustion kinetics of oil shale and its blended combustion with semi-coke.
the influence of semi-coke on the combustion of oil shale,which can provide theoretical support and technical basis for the industrial application of semi-coke in the combustion of oil shales.

the influence on each other and the combustion characteristics of Huadian oil shales and semi-coke blended combustion,which could provide a theoretical basis for the design of combustion process and the development of combustion technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

dual peaks of oil shale combustion could be attributed to different combustion of aromatic and aliphatic compounds,and the blended combustion of oil and semi-coke could be attributed to mutual influence of semi-coke and oil shale.
oil shale and semi-cokewere mutually influenced at the low temperature and the influence of oil shale on semi-cokewas more than that on oil shale.

the blended combustion of Huadian oil shales and 500℃ semicoke is a typical two-stage process with the initial stage being dominated by the combustion of semi-coke and the later stage by the combustion of oil shale.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the blended combustion of oil shales and 500℃semi-coke could effectively improve the reactivity and reduce ignition temperature of oil shale,while the blended combustion index and apparent activation energy were not sensitive to the blended proportion.

the dual peaks of oil shale combustion was caused by the different components of kerogen,which was consistent with the results of the literature,and the influence of oil shale and coal on each other was not obvious during the blending combustion process.
the blended combustion kinetics of oil shale and coal was similar,while the blended combustion kinetics was different from that of oil shale and biomass.
The main takeaway from our work is that
oil shale and 400℃-500℃ semi-cokes could be blended to achieve the optimal blending proportion and combustion performance.
the blended combustion of oil shales and semi-coke can be divided into three zones:oil shale combustion zone,single combustion zone of semi-coke and blended combustion zone of oil shale and coke.
oil shale and semi- coke can be used as blended fuel to improve the combustion characteristics.
